title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Here I am! What should we play, baseball or board games? Oh, you're working?

title: Talk 1
original: Where was I born, you ask? Well, umm...no idea. But that doesn't matter, right?

title: Talk 2
original: Hello, Professor Rhodes Island! Wait, am I calling you by the right name?...

title: Talk 3
original: Hm, what's my assignment today? To capture some long, sleek animals?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Hey! Don't knock on my backpack! Oh, sorry, I'm not mad, I'm just worried. If you're not careful, you could hurt your hand! Here, let me show you how it's done.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: If anyone dares to hurt you, I'll smash them with my baseball bat. Oh, uh... so... there really are people who hurt you? Um... actually, I'm not that good at fighting, hehe…

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: I love spending the whole day just walking down the street. I get to watch the people, enjoy the sunshine, and then… lose my way!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: You've been treating my sickness, and you gave me a place to live... you're really so kind...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, are you my big brother? Or big sister?... Well, doesn't matter! I'm not leaving you, even if you throw me out! It's not like I can walk far anyway.

title: Idle
original: Oh, the Doctor is busy. I'll just play by myself then...

title: Onboard
original: Hm? Where am I? Who am I?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I can make myself super tough! It's my only special skill!

title: Promotion 1
original: Promotion? What's a promotion?... Whatever, let's play for a bit longer! You and me, together!

title: Promotion 2
original: New position or not, I don't really care. All I want is to be by your side every day. Can you grant this tiny wish of mine?

title: Added to Squad
original: I've got lots of friends here!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Everybody, let's go!

title: Depart
original: We'll be fine if we stick together!

title: Begin Operation
original: Everyone, let's play!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I'm here~!

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Doctor!

title: Deployment 1
original: Ora ora!

title: Deployment 2
original: Hey, dummies, bring it on!

title: In Battle 1
original: Muda muda muda muda!

title: In Battle 2
original: C'mon, show me what you got!

title: In Battle 3
original: This is my playground!

title: In Battle 4
original: I won't back down!

title: 4-star Result
original: Was that tough? Didn't feel much different from any other battle.

title: 3-star Result
original: Homerun!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Safe!

title: Operation Failure
original: Aww... struck out…

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Just don't throw fireballs at me, okay?

title: Tap
original: Wow, fun!

title: Trust Tap
original: Hey Doctor! Can we play a little bit longer? Just a little bit!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Happy new year, Doctor! I'm looking for the place I was first found. It's somewhere around on the deck. Was it here… or there?... Hm? Why am I looking for it? Because I was actually having a cozy nap when you guys found me. The sunshine was so warm... And I want to take a nap like that again! Hehe...

title: Greeting
original: Heya! Doctor!

title: Birthday
original: Hey, hey, Doctor! Happy birthday! These are for you: this baseball bat, these mitts, and this baseball! Come on, let's play!... You still got work to do? You're working on your birthday? Can't you take a day off? Aww…

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Hehe, they're all busy having fun outside! I'm gonna pack up my bag a little, then get out and return with cool stuff loaded on my back! What's in my bag? A baseball, pair of mitts, and… Doctor, just between you and me, and promise to keep it from the Medical Department—I also got some snacks in there!
